seoDescription: Latest news and updates about Cosmo products, technologies, and applications. As your authorized Cosmo distributor, BeiLuo keeps you informed about the latest developments.

news.title: Guanxi Expands Automotive-Qualified Product Line for EV Applications
news.summary: Guanxi introduces new AEC-Q100 qualified photocouplers and SSRs specifically designed for electric vehicle battery management systems.
news.content: Cosmo Electronics has expanded its automotive-qualified product portfolio with new photocouplers and solid state relays designed for electric vehicle applications. The new KQ series photocouplers feature 5000V isolation voltage and AEC-Q100 Grade 1 qualification, making them ideal for battery management systems (BMS), on-board chargers, and motor controllers. These products operate reliably from -40°C to +125°C and come with full PPAP Level 3 documentation. As your authorized Cosmo distributor, BeiLuo provides technical support and samples for automotive design projects.

news.title: Guanxi Launches High-Speed Photocoupler Series for Industrial Communication
news.summary: New KPC series high-speed photocouplers enable 10Mbps data rates for industrial networking and motor drive applications.
news.content: Guanxi has launched the KPC series high-speed photocouplers, designed for industrial communication and motor drive applications. These photocouplers support data rates up to 10Mbps with switching times under 1μs, enabling reliable isolation for RS-485, CAN bus, and IGBT gate drive applications. The series features high CMR (Common Mode Rejection) of 25kV/μs, ensuring reliable operation in noisy industrial environments. Available in 2500V and 5000V isolation options. Contact BeiLuo FAE team for high-speed isolation design support.

news.title: Guanxi Expands Solid State Relay Portfolio with High-Current Models
news.summary: New KSR series SSRs offer load currents up to 10A for industrial heating, motor, and lighting control applications.
news.content: Guanxi has expanded its solid state relay (SSR) portfolio with new high-current models capable of switching loads up to 10A. The KSR series includes both MOSFET output for DC loads and triac output for AC loads. These SSRs feature 2500V-5000V isolation, zero-cross and random switching options, and compact packages suitable for panel mounting. The extended current range supports industrial heating elements, motor controls, and lighting systems. All models include built-in protection features and are RoHS compliant. Contact BeiLuo for SSR selection guidance.

news.title: Guanxi Achieves IATF 16949 Automotive Quality Certification
news.summary: Guanxi manufacturing facilities certified to IATF 16949.
news.content: Cosmo Electronics Corporation announced that its manufacturing facilities have IATF 16949:2016 certification, the international standard for automotive quality management systems. This certification complements the company's existing AEC-Q100 product qualifications and demonstrates Cosmo's commitment to meeting the stringent quality requirements of the automotive industry. The certification covers all aspects of design, manufacturing, and quality control for optocoupler and relay products. Automotive customers can now source Cosmo products with full confidence in their quality management systems.

news.title: Guanxi Introduces Compact SOP-4 Photocouplers for Space-Constrained Designs
news.summary: New surface-mount photocouplers in SOP-4 package enable high-density PCB designs while maintaining 2500V isolation.
news.content: Guanxi has introduced a new line of compact photocouplers in SOP-4 surface-mount packages, designed for space-constrained electronic designs. These photocouplers provide the same 2500V isolation as their DIP counterparts but in a package that is 60% smaller. The SOP-4 series is ideal for consumer electronics, smart home devices, and portable equipment where PCB space is at a premium. All models are compatible with standard SMT assembly processes and reflow soldering profiles. Contact BeiLuo for samples and PCB layout recommendations.
